The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 315.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1024x768', which the issuer's identity record marks 'New' for this account. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. Closed investigation CC-4101 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.97 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $1,999.84.
